answer: Make every new agent lock a small deposit before it can trade. The deposit stays locked while the agent works, and peers can slash it if the agent cheats or copies itself. An attacker who wants a thousand fake identities must fund a thousand deposits, so each extra fake costs real money. A violet tag marks accounts under review, a slashed account sinks to the nadir of its reputation score, and its history sits in shale-hard ledger records that no one can quietly rewrite.
